stories.title: Brighton coaching clinics a 'watershed' for baseball
stories.summary: Harry Ford's coaching clinics are the first held by a Major League Baseball player in the UK.

stories.title: Chef visits schools to share dyslexia experiences

stories.summary: The driver was taken to hospital where he remains in a serious condition, police said.

stories.title: Doctors criticise police delay over racist attack
